description: KS-06-01 AC7: two SPEED pickups end 5 s after the second, at 1.5x, never 2.25x. initialPickup and secondPickup sit directly in P1's straight path so no input is needed; the test injects secondPickup onto the board itself once the first POWERUP_COLLECTED is observed, since a real round never has two power-ups on the board at once.
